mapper.sql: SELECT r.game_id, r.rune_key, source.name AS rune_name, r.skill_key, s.name AS skill_name, s.status AS skill_status, r.sort_order FROM public.rune_skill_relations r JOIN public.runes source ON source.game_id = r.game_id AND source.rune_key = r.rune_key JOIN public.skills s ON s.game_id = r.game_id AND s.skill_key = r.skill_key WHERE r.game_id = #{gameId}

choose.when: ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, s.name ASC, r.skill_key ASC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY source.name ASC, r.rune_key ASC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.rune_skill_relations (game_id, rune_key, skill_key, sort_order) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{runeKey}, #{skillKey}, #{sortOrder}) ON CONFLICT (game_id, rune_key, skill_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE public.rune_skill_relations SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND rune_key = #{runeKey} AND skill_key = #{skillKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.rune_skill_relations WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND rune_key = #{runeKey} AND skill_key = #{skillKey}
